title: AI chat: text typed but not yet sent is lost when the chat pane learns its conversation id (deep link loading, or the new-conversation create answering)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named producer, measured by the developer of PR #33673 (#33562/#33567, Acceptance notes) with a rendered probe on `origin/main` `d95ddebc`. Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`). Filed as `finding` for triage; not graded or claimed by this seat (the ui lane takes P1/P2 only since 2026-11-15T05:05Z).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open ChatPane draft remount` and `is:issue is:open composer draft lost conversation` find only #33562 (the joined-restore fix, a different path: submitted text) and #32984 (unrelated items).

## What the user sees

In the AI chat (full page `/ai`, the console chat dock, the Studio copilot), text typed into the message box but NOT yet sent disappears when the conversation the pane belongs to becomes known:

- On a deep link to an existing conversation (`/ai/build/conv-7`), text typed while the conversation is still loading is gone when it loads (the box comes back empty).
- On a new conversation, after the first send, a second message typed (not sent) while `POST /conversations` is running is gone when the create answers; only the first message is sent.

A message the user SUBMITTED is never lost on either path (held and sent once; pinned by #33673's #33567 pin).

## Where (on `main`)

- `ChatPane` is keyed on `${chatApi}:${conversationId ?? 'pending'}`, and the composer's text lives inside the pane (`ChatbotEnhanced`'s textarea), so the remount from `…:pending` to the real id drops it.

## Acceptance

- A draft typed before the pane's id is known survives the remount on both paths (deep-link GET answering; new-conversation create answering), cursor at the end, nothing sent.
- Pins through the rendered page on both paths, red first on base. CONTROL: a submitted message is held and sent once as today; a draft in an already-open conversation is unchanged.
